ai / AI Study Assistant

From PDF to a grounded answer

How document extraction, vector retrieval and Gemini connect in AI Study Assistant.

PDF upload → Text chunks → Embeddings → ChromaDB → Retrieved context → Gemini

The problem

Study material often lives in long PDFs. AI Study Assistant brings document uploads, chat and revision tools into one application, so students can work with their own material.

How the system fits together

A Next.js / React frontend talks to a Python FastAPI backend. PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy support application data, while JWT authentication identifies users. PDF text is extracted and split into chunks; Sentence Transformers creates embeddings used by ChromaDB for retrieval.

The retrieval path

A question is used to retrieve relevant document chunks. Those chunks provide context for Gemini to generate an answer. Retrieval narrows the information presented to the model; it does not guarantee that every answer is correct.

Study tools and boundaries

The implementation includes Gemini-based quiz generation, summaries with basic or fallback paths, and sentence-based flashcards. The inspected upload path rebuilds the ChromaDB collection, so this should not be described as a persistent multi-document knowledge base.

What this project demonstrates

The project connects authentication, file processing, database persistence, a web interface and an external model API. The engineering focus is the path from an uploaded document to context-aware interaction, rather than a model trained from scratch.
